text: Design and ship interactive 3D/2D experiences to web, iOS and Android without writing code
quote: Spline is a web-based design tool for creating interactive 3D and 2D experiences — and shipping them to the web, iOS and Android without writing code.

text: Real-time cloud-based multiplayer editing where several people can edit the same file at once
quote: is multiplayer from the ground up: your files live in the cloud and several people can edit the same one at once

text: AI agent builds and edits full 3D scenes (objects, materials, lighting, animation, interactivity) from a text description
quote: The AI Agent builds and edits 3D scenes for you. Describe what you want and it does the work through the editor itself — creating objects, setting up materials and lighting, animating, wiring interactivity

text: AI-generated textures (grass, concrete, wood, ceramic, patterns) created just by typing a prompt
quote: Use Artificial Intelligence to generate textures like grass, concrete, wood, ceramic, and patterns just by typing!

text: Reusable components whose instances update automatically when the main component changes
quote: Components are objects that can be reused multiple times throughout your scene and whenever there are changes made to the main component all instances will update accordingly.

text: A Code API lets external code trigger actions, modify object properties, and drive scene behavior programmatically
quote: The Code API allows you to seamlessly integrate interactive 3D experiences into your projects, offering greater control and customization.

text: A native <spline-viewer> HTML web component can embed published scenes in any web builder, framework, or browser
quote: `<spline-viewer>` is a native HTML web component and can be used with most web builders, frameworks, or browsers.

text: Self-hosted export packages the entire project, assets, and Spline runtime as a self-contained ZIP for your own hosting
quote: The Self-Hosted export option in Spline allows you to export your entire project, including all assets and the Spline runtime, as a fully self-contained ZIP file.

text: A Real-time API lets you integrate external services, send/receive data, and automate responses to events
quote: The Real-time API feature in Spline allows you to integrate external services, retrieve or send data, and automate responses based on events.

text: Webhooks let a project listen for external events and automatically trigger actions or update variables in response
quote: Webhooks in Spline allow you to create real-time, event-driven interactions by listening for and responding to external events.

text: A file can embed a full HTML/CSS/JS document rendered in a sandboxed iframe layered over the 3D canvas
quote: A file can carry one HTML document — markup, CSS and JavaScript — that the editor renders in a sandboxed iframe layered exactly over the 3D canvas.

text: Scenes can be exported as production code: Vanilla JS, Three.js, React, Next.js, or react-three-fiber
quote: Spline allows you to export the code of your scene as: Vanilla JS, Three.js, React, Next.js, react-three-fiber

text: An official Spline MCP Server lets MCP clients like Claude, Cursor, and Codex drive the editor directly
quote: Spline MCP Server — drive Spline from Claude, Cursor, Codex and other MCP clients, straight into your open editor tab.

text: Desktop app supports working across multiple files in tabs and uses installed system fonts
quote: the desktop app gives you a few things the browser can't: tabs for working across several files, system fonts, and MCP support

text: Version History lets you preview, track, manually save, and recover previous versions of a file
quote: Version History allows you to access and preview all the saved versions of your files. This feature helps you track changes, recover previous file states, and manually save new versions as needed.

text: Hana AI generates a UI screen design from a text description, which can then be hand-edited
quote: describe a screen and Hana designs it, then edit it by hand

text: Most interactivity requires no code — built from a no-code system of states, events and actions
quote: Most interactivity in Spline needs no code at all. It's built from **states, events and actions**

text: Team Library feature for sharing assets/components across a team
quote:
Code & Self-hosted exports
*   File version history
*   Team Library

text: Desktop app's bundled MCP server auto-registers with Claude, Cursor, VS Code, Antigravity or ChatGPT with zero install/config
quote: connecting Claude, Cursor, VS Code, Antigravity or ChatGPT to your editor only works here — there's nothing to install or configure, the app registers itself with the clients it finds when it launches
